datasheet_identity.title: MM1W3V3 THRU MM1W330 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the MM1W18 row was selected from the MM1W3V3 through MM1W330 table.
The MM1W18 zener row specifies VZ minimum 16.8 V, nominal 18 V, and maximum 19.2 V at IZT = 14 mA; the nominal value is used for the paired breakdown voltage and test-current semantics.
The MM1W18 row specifies maximum zener impedance ZZT = 20 ohm at IZT = 14 mA and admissible zener current IZM = 52 mA; no ZZK/IZK knee-impedance value is published.

No component-specific usable electrical curve is published. Page 1 contains a generic zener function diagram, while page 3 contains only family-level power-derating and transient thermal-impedance plots, so no plotted diode points were extracted.
No capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is published in the supplied datasheet.
extraction.omission_reason: No usable component-specific diode curve exists in the supplied datasheet: the only relevant drawing is a generic zener function diagram, and the plotted curves are unrelated thermal characteristics.
